result.title: MT Forcing: Towards Stable and Consistent Multi-Turn Image Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
result.summary: Multi-turn image editing aims to modify an image according to a sequence of instructions, enabling more effective interactive visual content creation for users. However, existing methods often exhibit noticeable drift after only a few editing turns, manifesting in two aspects: 1) unstable visual quality, with accumulating artifacts and degraded details; and 2) inconsistent image content, with unintended changes to preserved regions and prior edits. To address these challenges, we propose MT Forcing, a novel training paradigm for multi-turn image editing with unified multimodal models (UMMs) based on autoregressive diffusion. Specifically, we propose Single-Turn Distribution Matching Distillation (Single-Turn DMD), which supervises student self-rollouts with a teacher that applies cumulative edits to the source image in a single turn, providing visual-quality guidance without recursive error accumulation. Additionally, we introduce Teacher-Forcing Guidance, which supervises history-dependent transitions on reference trajectories during warmup and as a regularizer during distillation, encouraging cross-turn content consistency beyond what per-turn distribution matching alone can ensure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves the multi-turn image editing capabilities of UMMs, yielding more stable visual quality and stronger cross-turn consistency.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MT Forcing 训练范式，用「单轮累积编辑」的教师模型监督学生的自 rollout 做分布匹配蒸馏（Single-Turn DMD），并引入 Teacher-Forcing Guidance 作为预热监督与蒸馏正则，以缓解多轮图像编辑中的视觉质量漂移与跨轮内容不一致。
AI.relevance_reason: 多轮自 rollout 与教师强制的混合监督、递归误差累积的规避、跨轮历史依赖状态的一致性约束，可能为 LVR 的 latent 轨迹训练与贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索；但研究对象是图像编辑而非视觉推理，需人工判断迁移价值。
